email_subject: Application - Digital Marketing Assistant at Brussels Marriott Hotel
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Marketing Assistant role at Brussels Marriott Hotel, as advertised on Hosco. With hands-on experience in SEO, content management, and digital campaign support, I am eager to bring my skills to your marketing team.

In my current roles at Episto and as a freelancer, I manage online content for client websites, ensuring accuracy and consistency across platforms. I have supported the development of digital marketing campaigns, prepared performance reports using Google Analytics and Search Console, and collaborated with designers and suppliers on marketing materials. My proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint, combined with strong writing skills, allows me to handle administrative tasks and reporting efficiently.

I am highly organized, comfortable multitasking under pressure, and passionate about social media and content creation. I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to Brussels Marriott Hotel's digital presence.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Digital Marketing Assistant position at Brussels Marriott Hotel, as listed on Hosco. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and content management, I am confident in my ability to support your team in enhancing the hotel's online presence and executing creative campaigns.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage CMS content for client websites, ensuring all pages and media are up-to-date and aligned with brand guidelines. I have experience in on-page SEO, keyword research, and content creation, which I believe will be valuable in maintaining and improving your website and third-party platform content. Additionally, I have supported the development of digital marketing campaigns, tracked their performance using Google Analytics and Search Console, and prepared reports to monitor budgets—skills directly relevant to your requirement for monthly marketing reports and budget monitoring.

My freelance work has further honed my ability to collaborate with designers and suppliers on marketing materials. For instance, I built and optimized mirook.com, implementing structured data and running technical audits to improve search visibility. I also created a free site-check enquiry flow on baverok.com, demonstrating my initiative and ability to manage projects independently. These experiences have strengthened my organizational and multitasking skills, enabling me to prioritize tasks effectively under pressure.

I am proficient in MS Excel and PowerPoint, and I have a keen interest in social media platforms including Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn. I am also familiar with publishing tools and design best practices, which I apply when creating content for websites and social channels. My writing skills are strong, with excellent spelling and grammar, and I am comfortable handling administrative tasks such as invoices and contracts.

I am a team player with a professional demeanor, and I am eager to contribute to the Sales & Marketing Director's day-to-day operations. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills align with the needs of Brussels Marriott Hotel.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,

cv_highlights:
• CMS content management: publishing and updating pages, blog posts, and media for client websites in WordPress, ensuring content is current and accurate.
• Experience in supporting digital marketing campaigns, tracking performance with Google Analytics and Search Console, and preparing reports.
• Proficient in MS Excel and PowerPoint for reporting and administrative tasks; strong writing skills with excellent spelling and grammar.
• Familiar with social media platforms (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn) and design best practices; experience in content creation for promotional use.
• Highly organized and able to multitask under pressure; collaborative team player with experience working with designers and suppliers.
